name: @centralchat/react-native-widget
description: The Central chat in a React Native app — three calls and one component, over the same page the web embed loads.
//main: Shipped as TypeScript source rather than a build output. Metro already transpiles node_modules with the React Native babel preset, so there is nothing a prebuilt lib/ would add except a second artifact to keep in step — and a stack trace that points at code you cannot read.
//peerDependencies: react-native-webview is the ONLY one, and it is the reason this package has no native code of its own: no pods, no autolinking, and it runs in Expo Go.
